initial.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-02] Documentation review and external-review handoff
initial.goal: Produce one exact-revision documentation review and context-free external-review handoff for v0.92.1.
initial.required_outcome: One exact-revision documentation-review packet with a context-free external-review handoff, grounded claims, and explicit residual risks.
authority_boundary: Execution starts only after #517 has a reviewed merge
The issue reviews and repairs documentation truth but does not implement product behavior or publish
Typed finish and cleanup of #517 are non-gating
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Bind every claim and review artifact to one exact candidate revision
Use resolvable repository paths or canonical issue references
Do not publish, merge, tag, or release
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one exact-revision documentation-review and external-handoff packet; document checks are evidence inputs.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every canonical v0.92.1 document is inventoried and agrees with current authority
AC-2: Links, paths, issue references, and claims are resolvable and source-grounded
AC-3: Residual risks, deferred scope, and non-claims are explicit
AC-4: The review and handoff bind one exact candidate revision
initial.plan_summary: After #517 merges, freeze the candidate, inventory canonical documents, resolve documentation findings, and emit one exact-revision review plus context-free external handoff.

steps.action: Verify #517 reviewed-merge authority and freeze the exact documentation candidate.
Build the canonical document denominator and validate every path, link, issue reference, and authority claim.
Resolve in-scope documentation findings and record residual risks, deferred scope, and non-claims.
Emit and validate the exact-revision documentation review and context-free external handoff packet.

invariants: One exact revision anchors the packet
Documentation never overstates product or release state
The issue does not publish the candidate
risks: A canonical document could be omitted
A local-only path could make the handoff non-portable
Candidate drift could stale the review
Documentation could conceal a residual risk
stop_conditions: A required input cannot be resolved

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the complete canonical v0.92.1 documentation denominator.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned validator is an execution deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove every tracked path, link, and issue reference resolves.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned validator is an execution deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove claims, residual risks, deferred scope, and non-claims are source-grounded.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned validator is an execution deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove repository diff hygiene for the exact documentation candidate.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on an unmet predecessor, incomplete document denominator, unresolved input, unsupported claim, hidden residual risk, or candidate drift.
review_prompts: Is the canonical document denominator complete?
Can every path, link, issue reference, and claim be resolved context-free?
Are residual risks and non-claims explicit?
Is the packet bound to one exact candidate revision?
initial.review_scope: The exact documentation candidate, canonical inventory, links and claims, residual risks, and external-review handoff.
